```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
history <- open_dataset("data/history.parquet")
markets <- read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")
market_groups <- read_parquet("data/market_groups.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  collect() |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    absolute_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date),
    time_bucket = case_when(
      days_to_resolution > 90 ~ "More than 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 30 ~ "30 to 90 days",
      days_to_resolution > 7 ~ "7 to 30 days",
      days_to_resolution > 0 ~ "1 to 7 days",
      days_to_resolution == 0 ~ "Final day"
    ),
    time_bucket = factor(
      time_bucket,
      levels = c(
        "More than 90 days",
        "30 to 90 days",
        "7 to 30 days",
        "1 to 7 days",
        "Final day"
      ),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
accuracy <- joined |>
  group_by(time_bucket) |>
  summarise(
    mean_absolute_error = mean(absolute_error),
    snapshots = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(time_bucket)

print(accuracy)

accuracy |>
  ggplot(aes(x = time_bucket, y = mean_absolute_error, group = 1)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Prediction markets get smarter near the deadline",
    subtitle = "Mean absolute error in Manifold Markets forecasts, by days remaining",
    x = "Days remaining",
    y = "Mean absolute error"
  )
```

```{r}
joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = probability)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecast probabilities",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Number of snapshots"
  )
```

```{r}
calibration <- joined |>
  filter(days_to_resolution == 0) |>
  mutate(
    probability_bin = cut(
      probability,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1),
      labels = paste0(seq(0, 90, by = 10), "-", seq(10, 100, by = 10), "%"),
      include.lowest = TRUE,
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(probability_bin, .drop = FALSE) |>
  summarise(
    actual_rate = if (n() == 0L) NA_real_ else mean(outcome_numeric),
    n = n_distinct(market_id),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(probability_bin)

print(calibration)

calibration |>
  mutate(predicted_probability = (as.numeric(probability_bin) - 0.5) / 10) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = predicted_probability, y = actual_rate)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(size = n)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    limits = c(0, 1)
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Markets in bin", range = c(2, 8)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    title = "Final-day forecasts are nearly calibrated at the extremes",
    x = "Predicted probability",
    y = "Actual resolution rate"
  )
```
